Request_gzip = True

rows.answer:
Yes. The behavior described in issue #78 (requests should send 'Accept-Encoding': 'gzip') is now implemented by default: default_headers() includes an Accept-Encoding header built from DEFAULT_ACCEPT_ENCODING, which is derived from make_headers(accept_encoding=True) and therefore includes gzip (src/requests/utils.py:85-93, src/requests/utils.py:911-962). The Session applies these default headers to every request (src/requests/sessions.py:442-488). The relevant commit that established the default Accept-Encoding header is 1b70385d4ae7 ("change default accept-encoding").
